metadata.description: Session-rail mods for Claude Code: one session pane with a plan usage card and a todo stack that survives compaction.

plugins.name: session-rail
plugins.description: One session pane that other mods add cards to, with a button above the prompt to reopen it.

plugins.name: usage-rail
plugins.description: Adds a usage card to the session pane: session limit, weekly limit and cloud session credit, as the app's usage card shows them.

plugins.name: todo-stack
plugins.description: Adds a todo card to the session pane that stacks every todo the model creates, request by request, so none is lost to compaction.
